title: Unctuous Yeasty Chinese Pork Baozi
description: Indulgent Chinese baozi filled with yeasty dough and pork, featuring dijon mustard and a dairy-free friendly recipe, the dough is shock cooled in an ice bath to create a shaggy texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add in oil and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in an ice bath to shock cool for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together chopped pork, dijon mustard, and scallions.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of pork filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a baozi and seal the edges.
Steam the baozi for 15 minutes until cooked through.
